items.summary: Convert a vector of json values to a RecordBatch

items.name: ShareableBuffer
items.summary: An in memory buffer that allows for shared ownership and interior mutability. The underlying buffer is wrapped in an `Arc` and `RwLock`, so cloning the instance allows multiple owners to have access to the same underlying buffer.

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.summary: Creates a new instance with buffer initialized from the underylying bytes.

methods.name: into_inner
methods.summary: Consumes this instance and returns the underlying buffer. Returns None if there are other references to the instance.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if the underlying buffer is empty.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of bytes in the underlying buffer.

methods.name: to_vec
methods.summary: Returns a clone of the underlying buffer as a `Vec`.
